decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood drink mix it fits the firm's core industrial technology and engineering business poorly, so management would likely refocus those resources on scalable B2B sustainability solutions.

Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions are closely aligned with the firm's established decentralized energy and waste-conversion offer and can strengthen the installed-base business with relatively low additional risk.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a clear strategic fit, had dedicated product visibility from launch, and matches the firm's strengths in practical waste-to-value technologies.
A plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's existing offer, gained stronger standalone positioning after launch, and supports its long-term expansion in circular-economy technologies.
